issues.description: The problem statement/UML specifies a static method SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(Meal): int, but the solution implements the corresponding functionality as SealSaloon.computeMealCost(Meal): int. Students (and tests) looking for calculateTotalPrice will not find it, causing compilation/test failures and confusion about the required API.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename SealSaloon.computeMealCost(Meal) to calculateTotalPrice(Meal) (keeping it static), or add a calculateTotalPrice(Meal) wrapper delegating to computeMealCost(Meal). Update Main accordingly.

issues.description: The problem statement requires acceptSupplyDelivery(String,int,int) to be static, but the provided Main example calls it as if it were an instance method (shop.acceptSupplyDelivery(...)). This conflicts with the specified API and can mislead students about whether to implement it static or instance.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the example call to SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery("Bacon", 50, 100) (or remove/adjust the example if you want it to be instance-based).
